北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光正好，体感 9℃。早晚温差大，多喝水防干燥哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, feels like 9℃. Mind the temperature change and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 11℃。天气微凉，出门别忘添衣，备把伞更安心。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast, feels like 11℃. It's cool, dress warmly and keep an umbrella handy.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 10℃。微凉，多穿点，注意保暖，出门别忘带伞哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels like 10℃. It's cool, dress warmly and bring an umbrella.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，体感 19℃。天气舒适，出门散步很棒，但昼夜温差留意哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels like 19℃. Pleasant weather, enjoy your stroll!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 21℃。天气宜人，微风送爽，户外活动别忘了防晒哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 21℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather and light breeze!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 10℃。气温微凉，多穿件衣服，注意保暖，防范着凉哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast, feels like 10℃. It's a bit cool, dress warmly and stay cozy.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 9℃。微凉，记得多穿点，注意保暖，别着凉感冒哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast, feels like 9℃. It's cool, dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 17℃。天气适宜，出门享受，但昼夜温差大，别忘了添衣哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 17℃. Pleasant, but mind the temp difference and dress in layers.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉霾天，体感 13℃。出行请做好防护，戴口罩，多喝水，保护呼吸健康。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, feels like 13℃. Wear a mask and stay hydrated for respiratory health.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 13℃。天气干燥，请多喝水，润肤保湿，注意防火安全哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels like 13℃. It's very dry, stay hydrated, moisturize, and mind fire safety.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 16℃。天气适宜，微风拂面，享受美好时光，记得防晒哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 16℃. Pleasant weather, enjoy the breeze and remember sun protection.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感 -6℃。严寒，请务必全副武装，戴好帽子手套，注意防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, feels like -6℃. It's freezing, bundle up with hats and gloves to stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 2℃。风力大，体感更冷，多穿几层，注意头部保暖哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like 2℃. Windy and cold, layer up and keep your head warm.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 15℃。风力稍大，日晒充足，记得防晒和适时补水哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 15℃. It's breezy and sunny, remember sunscreen and hydration.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 15℃。舒适宜人，微风不燥，享受海边惬意时光，注意防晒。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 15℃. Pleasant, enjoy the coastal breeze and remember sun protection.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛霾天，体感 2℃。寒冷多风，出门请做好防护，多穿衣物，小心着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has haze, feels like 2℃. Cold and windy, take precautions, dress warmly, stay cozy.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 5℃。天气微凉，多穿衣物，外出记得做好保暖，享受阳光哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like 5℃. It's cool, dress warmly, enjoy the sunshine, and stay cozy.
